name: aboutyowkey-api
description: The portfolio's backend: visit and link-click counts, a feedback inbox, private messages and the owner's alerts, on a Cloudflare Worker with a D1 database.

scripts.inbox: wrangler d1 execute aboutyowkey --remote --command "SELECT id, created_at, rating, name, contact, consent, published_at, hidden_at, message FROM feedback ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50"
